title: Slow Steps Beside the Pond
paras: Tuesday, 8 a.m. The air beside Willow Pond was cool after rain. I came by [[subway|subway]] with my [[father-in-law|father-in-law]], Omar, for our weekly nature walk. He is the [[leader|leader]] of our small walking group. Our [[main|main]] aim is to move our bodies gently and notice small things outside. Before we reached the park, we stopped at a [[drugstore|drugstore]] for water and tissues. Then we followed the narrow path towards the pond.

Near the water, we met Rosa, a [[hairdresser|hairdresser]], and Mei, a regular [[customer|customer]] at her shop. Rosa spends most of her working day indoors, so she enjoys these quiet mornings. We stopped under a tree to [[collect|collect]] fallen leaves for our nature notebooks. We left living plants alone. I counted [[several|several]] tiny snails on one wet leaf. Mei noticed that they moved more slowly when the sun came out.

We walked for twenty minutes, then sat on a wooden seat. Omar was [[pleased|pleased]] that everyone could finish without rushing. My shoulders felt less tight, and Rosa said her feet felt better after sitting down. Across the pond, a grey bird stood in the shallow water. We watched it catch a small fish before we closed our notebooks and headed home.
zh: 星期二，上午八点。雨后，柳树池塘边的空气很凉爽。我和配偶的父亲奥马尔乘地铁来参加每周一次的自然散步。他是我们这个小小步行团的带领者。我们的主要目的是让身体做些轻缓的活动，同时留意户外的细小事物。到公园前，我们在一家药店买了水和纸巾，然后沿着窄窄的小路走向池塘。
在水边，我们遇到了理发师罗莎，以及她店里的常客梅。罗莎一天中大部分工作时间都在室内，所以她很喜欢这样安静的早晨。我们在一棵树下停下来，收集落叶，准备放进自然观察笔记本。我们没有碰还在生长的植物。我在一片湿叶子上数到了几只小蜗牛。梅注意到，太阳出来后，它们爬得更慢了。
我们走了二十分钟，然后在一张木椅上坐下。大家不用赶路就能走完全程，奥马尔对此很高兴。我的肩膀没那么紧绷了，罗莎说坐下后双脚舒服了一些。池塘对面，一只灰色的鸟站在浅水中。我们看着它捉到一条小鱼，才合上笔记本回家。

q.s: The writer and Omar walked all the way from home to the park.
q.why: 他们乘地铁前来，并非全程步行。

q.s: The group collected fallen leaves for their notebooks.
q.why: 他们收集落叶，用于自然观察笔记本。

q.s: The grey bird stays at the pond during winter.
q.why: 文章未提及这只鸟冬天是否留在池塘。
